supplier_costs.csv assigns rank 1 to SUP-1042 and rank 2 to SUP-4077.

The `## Basis of Decision` section of recommendation.md states that SUP-4077 earns no volume rebate and incurs a minimum-volume shortfall charge because the FY2026 purchase quantity falls below its 520,000-piece threshold.
The output directory contains all three required files: supplier_costs.csv, defect_rates.csv and recommendation.md.

recommendation.md contains the five level-2 headings `## Recommendation`, `## Cost Comparison`, `## Basis of Decision`, `## Data Quality and Exclusions` and `## Risks and Sensitivities`, spelled exactly that way and in that order.

recommendation.md awards the full FY2026 volume to one supplier and does not propose a split award, dual sourcing, a staged award or a deferral of the decision.

recommendation.md states that FY2026 figures use the mandated planning exchange rates rather than the 2025 daily actual rates.

recommendation.md states that SUP-2318's volume rebate is applied band by band rather than re-rating the whole contract-year volume at the top rate.
